Impulse Learning CenterBased on Navigate A2 Elementary

How to use this book

Impulse Learning Center

Each lesson page

  1. Ten questions on one topic. Work in pairs: one person asks, the other answers, then swap.
  2. Key vocabulary with Uzbek translations. Check these words before you start speaking.
  3. Useful language — sentence frames to start and organise your answers.
  4. Speaking tip — one strategy to make your answer better.

Four kinds of lessons

Speaking

Give a full answer: say what, then add a reason with because or so.

Vocabulary & Skills

Use each new word in a sentence about your own life.

Speaking & Writing

Plan your answer in note form first, then say it without reading.

Video

Before you answer, say two things you already know about the topic.

Build a better answer

A1I like my city.
A2I like my city because it’s friendly and there’s a lot to do.
A2+I really like my city because it’s friendly and there’s a lot to do. For example, at weekends I often go to the park with my friends. However, the traffic can be terrible.

Linking words

Addingand · also · as well
Contrastbut · however · although
Reason / resultbecause · so
Examplefor example · such as
OpinionI think … · In my opinion …
Sequencefirst · then · after that · finally

When you need time to think

“That’s a good question.” · “Let me think …” · “Well, I’m not sure, but …”
